literal: Yesterday departed our lover; we also seven days-we are, body having paled.
translation: Our lover departed only yesterday, but my body has already paled for seven days.
modern: எம் காதலர் நேற்றுதான் பிரிந்து சென்றார், ஆனால் என் மேனி பசலை நிறம் அடைந்து ஏழு நாட்கள் ஆகிவிட்டன.
explanation: The heroine playfully exaggerates her lovesickness to her friend. She points out a logical impossibility: her lover left only yesterday, yet her body has borne the pallor of separation for seven days. This hyperbole emphasizes how time stretches agonizingly when she is apart from him, making a single day feel like a week. The contrast between 'yesterday' and 'seven days' highlights the immediate and intense physical effect of his absence.
